title: Anthropic IPO set to price this week

timeline.title: Anthropic IPO set to price this week
timeline.line: 825 million shares at $70–78; trading as ANT reportedly from 19 November
more: Renaissance Capital sizes the offer at $61 billion
Valuation estimates vary from about $1 trillion to $1.4 trillion
Final price and date not yet confirmed

src.title: Anthropic sets terms for $61 billion IPO targeting a $1.2 trillion market cap
